docs.summary: A camera defined by the source file. Position and orientation come from the [`ModelNode`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ModelNode) that references it; this carries only the lens.
docs.remarks: The camera aims down its node's -Z and is +Y up, as the source defines it. For a Y up source `ConvertCoordinateSystem` negates X, which leaves that direction alone, so an engine that looks down +Z turns it half a turn about Y.

docs.summary: Camera name, or `null` when the source did not name it.

members.name: Projection
members.signature: public required CameraProjection Projection { get; init; }

docs.summary: Which of the two parameter sets below applies.
Vertical field of view in radians. Perspective only.
Width divided by height, or `null` when the source left it undefined, which means the camera should take the aspect of whatever it is rendering into. Perspective only.
Half the width of the view volume. Orthographic only.
Half the height of the view volume. Orthographic only.
Distance to the near clipping plane. Always greater than zero.
Distance to the far clipping plane, or `null` for an infinite projection. glTF allows a perspective camera to omit it; orthographic cameras always have one.
